page.overview:
Who is Jared?

Soyona Santos's Dinosaur Trafficking Ring}} Jared was a minor antagonist in the first season of Jurassic World: Chaos Theory who catches dinosaurs alongside his partner Jensen in order to deliver the animals to Soyona Santos. He was killed by a Becklespinax.

Jared and Jensen arrived at the Dinosaur Free Zone and began firing at Ben, Sammy, and Yasmina, popping their tires to prevent them from escaping the Becklespinax.

Jared and Jensen were putting a Becklespinax Jared shot it with a tranquilizer dart causing it to collapse shortly after entering the container.

They zapped the Becklespinax multiple times before being scolded by Dudley Cabrera. He was later patrolling near the containers where Sammy and Yaz revealed they were there, he chased after them giving Ben an opportunity to free Bumpy. He began firing at them in an attempt to stop them. After Yaz and Sammy stole a vehicle, he got into another vehicle and pursued them into the enclosure where multiple Dinosaurs were being held. Yaz took a sharp turn near a water source, Jared wasn't able to turn fast enough causing him to go into the water. He exited his vehicle with a tranq gun and was attacked by a Becklespinax, killing him. with parasaurolophus, stegosaurus and many other herbivorous dinosaurs watching Jared get killed.
